content:
**#818 — the record filename is a grammar, not a month: the #637 suite stops expiring**

Five assertions in brain/scripts/memory/backends/plainfiles.save-index-failure.test.mjs pinned the record file to the literal 2026-08. Production derives that month from record.ts.slice(0,7) — the clock — so the two agreed for seventeen days and main went red on 2026-09-01. The fuse was armed 2026-08-15 by 0ee898b (#677), which put the month prefix into the filename.

ROOT CAUSE, not the literal: store.mjs:38 declares recordFilename() 'the ONE place that maps a record to its file, so the layout is stated once and every reader/writer/migration agrees by construction rather than by three copies of a template string.' The test was a fourth copy.

THE FIX distinguishes two kinds of assertion. Where the test asserts a SHAPE (4 sites), it now states the grammar itself, once, month-agnostic: RECORD_FILE = \d{4}-\d{2}-rec-[0-9a-f]{16}\.jsonl, with path-anchored, in-text and bare-basename variants. Importing the production regex would have made it pass even if production broke the grammar — a shape assertion must be able to disagree with the code it checks. Where the test asserts an EXACT string (the byte-identical stdout), it rebuilds the name through recordFilename(), because that test pins the CLI MESSAGE, not the layout. The helper augustLines becomes recordLines and filters on the record-file grammar: it must skip the deliberate 2026-07.jsonl month-log fixture, and the grammar says so directly where the month prefix was only ever a proxy.

MEASURED, not argued. A clock-shift harness (--import a module subclassing Date with an offset) set to 2027-03-15 makes the code write 2027-03-rec-<id>.jsonl. Under it the OLD suite scores 5 pass / 5 fail and the NEW one 10 pass / 0 fail. The same shifted clock over brain/scripts/**/*.test.mjs: 4454 tests, 0 fail — so this was the only date bomb, latent ones included, measured rather than statically swept. Mutation check: dropping the month prefix from recordFilename returns the suite to 5 fail, so the fix keeps its teeth.

GREEN: full suite 4520 pass / 0 fail; brain:repo:check clean. Diff 31 insertions / 15 deletions, one file, against the lite tier's 1000-line budget.

GOTCHA for the clock harness: spawnSync children do NOT inherit the --import patch, so CLI-subprocess tests run on the real clock. Harmless here because the parent reads the record's own ts back off disk.
